title: Tenure Months Added to Home-Site Lease Repayment Plans
content:
Tenure adds plan months to a Home-Site Lease repayment plan, read from the full calendar months of tenancy since the move-in date on the lease.

| Full months of tenancy since the move-in date | Plan months added |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | 2 |
| at least 60 but fewer than 120 | 1 |
| fewer than 60 | none |

**At the thresholds**

| Tenure | Plan months added |
|---|---|
| exactly 120 months | 2 |
| 119 months | 1 |
| exactly 60 months | 1 |
| 59 months | none |

*Hypothetical.* A plan of 4 plan months for a resident with 130 months of tenancy becomes 6 plan months; for a resident with 72 months, 5; for a resident with 40 months, it stays at 4.
